description: The Ka-Bar USMC Combo Edge Fighting Knife is an iconic blade, modeled after the legendary USMC Fighting Knife. This combat knife combines the best of both worlds with a combo edge, offering the versatility of a plain edge for clean cuts and a serrated edge for tougher tasks. Measuring 12 inches in total length, with a 7-inch powder-coated blade, this military knife is built for durability and long-lasting performance. The serrated leather grip ensures superior maneuverability and control, making it an excellent choice for demanding situations. Accompanying the military fighting knife is a finely crafted leather sheath, engraved with the U.S.M.C. emblem and name, providing secure storage and a touch of authenticity. Proudly made in the United States, this fighting knife is a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts alike. Please note, this item is restricted for export and cannot be sold for use in some countries outside the U.S.
